blurb: Guests operate their own jet skis following a guide on a 2-hour tour of NYC Harbor and the Upper Hudson River. The tour includes views of Ellis Island, the Vessel at Hudson Yards, the Statue of Liberty, and the Palisades. No prior jet ski experience is required; safety training and gear are provided.
